custodianAssessment.localOrScopedEvidence: The official Talca municipal Geoportal identifies the municipality/SECPLAN as publisher of territorial information and exposes municipal planning and municipal-property layers. The official municipal directory identifies CATASTRO in the Dirección de Obras. This establishes a local custodian, but not a successfully accessed citywide cadastral parcel service.
custodianAssessment.generalAgencyEvidence: SII official pages describe national Cartografía Digital property-map functionality and parcel fields. MINVU/IDE exposes a Talca Plan Regulador Comunal planning layer. These were treated as general/national or planning evidence, not as proof of a local parcel API.

discovery.englishQuery: Talca Chile official cadastral parcel map GIS catastro visor predial Municipalidad de Talca
discovery.nativeQuery: Talca Chile catastro visor predial oficial municipal parcelas

requests.outcome: 200 HTML; official municipal Geoportal source read successfully. Current JavaScript contains embedded PRC zoning GeoJSON and one municipal-property feature, but no fetch/XHR/ArcGIS parcel service, parcel schema, or full cadastral layer. The municipal-property attributes included owner-linked RUT/name and document URLs, so they were not retained.

200 HTML; official SII property-tax page read successfully. It links the SII Cartografía Digital viewer at https://www4.sii.cl/mapasui/internet/#/contenido/index.html and describes map lookup of property location, rol and tax attributes. No anonymous parcel geometry response or public service configuration was obtained from this page.

Identified by the official SII page as the cartography viewer. No login, credentials, CAPTCHA bypass, private token, or unsafe owner/address query was attempted; no anonymous API response was retained.
200 JSON metadata; official Talca Plan Regulador Comunal layer identified as esriGeometryPolygon in EPSG:4326 with planning fields. This is a planning layer, not cadastral parcel evidence.
HTTP 400 from the official ArcGIS query route; no feature response accepted. The failed query was against a planning layer and was not evidence of parcel absence.
HTTP 200 JSON error object with ArcGIS code 400, Failed to execute query; no feature response accepted. No retry with altered credentials or unsafe fields.

responseEvidence.geometry: No cadastral parcel geometry retained or verified. The municipal page's embedded geometry was an owner-linked municipal property and the MINVU geometry is planning-zone geometry; neither qualifies as a safe general parcel sample.
safeFieldAllowlist: stable native parcel identity if a future public response exposes one

sample.reason: No safe general cadastral parcel ID-plus-geometry response was obtained. No sample GeoJSON is retained.
sample.exactPointHit: not tested against a parcel layer; no coordinate shift performed

scopeLimits: The municipal Geoportal is evidence of a local public map and custodian, not evidence of complete citywide cadastral coverage.
The SII cartography viewer may require an interactive workflow and its documented interoperable services are restricted to nominated municipal users; no authentication was attempted.
The MINVU Talca layer is planning-zoning data and its query returned an error; this does not establish parcel absence.
No CRS, parcel identity field, or geometry response from a general Talca parcel service was verified.
No login, credentials, private token, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, owner/address/contact/titleholder query, or TLS certificate exception was used.
No source integration, adapter admission, or runtime qualification is claimed.
uncertainty: A local municipal custodian and official territorial map are evidenced, but the public municipal viewer exposes no general parcel service in its current source and the national SII viewer was not anonymously interrogated. Citywide parcel coverage and safe native parcel identity remain unqualified.
